notes.title: The demo v.2.0 is available now! #SteamVisualNovelFest
notes.content:
[b]Demo v.2.0 ^^ [/b]

[i]Immerse yourself in a dramatic story, deal with the cycles of time in a shattered world — come face to face with deadly mysteries.[/i]

Main changes:

1. Rewritten script from scratch.
2. New content: including CG, locations, events.
3. Graphics, interface — have been significantly reworked and improved.
4. A lot of work has been done on the sound design.

[i]...Chronos α, Antiquity β, Legacy σ.[/i]
